newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sembawang extends offer for SML.
newsitem.headline: Sembawang extends offer for SML.

text.p: Sembawang Corp has extended its takeover offer period for Sembawang Maritime Ltd (SML) by four days to October 14, Standard Chartered Bank said on Monday.

"The voluntary offer will remain open for acceptance until 3.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) on Friday, October 18 or such later dates as the offeror may announce," the bank said in a statement on behalf of Sembawang.

Ship-repair conglomerate Sembawang has offered Singapore $3.70 each for all outstanding shares in logistics and salvage company SML. Sembawang already held about a third of SML's shares when the takeover offer was announced in August.
SML shares were suspended on Monday. It last traded at S$3.62. --Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
